title: Canonical structure maps commute with derived base change
statement: Choose shared derived categories of modules on schemes [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $f:X\to S$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$, $g:S\prime\to S$ and $p:X\prime\to X$ be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme] with $pf=f\prime g$. Let $a_f:\mathcal O_S[0]\to Rf_*\mathcal O_X[0]$ be the single ordinary structure map followed by canonicalSingleDirectImageMap [lem-pc-canonical-single-direct-image-comparison], and similarly define $a_{f\prime}$. Let $j_g:Lg^*\mathcal O_S[0]\to\mathcal O_{S\prime}[0]$ be canonicalSinglePullbackMap followed by the single of the adjoint structure map, and similarly define $j_p$ [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison, lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf]. For the pinned derived base-change map $\beta$ [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], the identity $Lg^*(a_f)\gg\beta_{\mathcal O_X[0]}\gg Rf\prime_*(j_p)=j_g\gg a_{f\prime}$ holds, where $\gg$ means first the left map, then the right map. No cartesianness, flatness, vanishing or invertibility hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Apply canonicalSingleBaseChangeComparison to the structure module. Expand functoriality and reassociate. Naturality of canonicalSingleDirectImageMap (proved from the inverse single-complex comparison and the right-derived unit) moves the ordinary p-structure map to the target. Naturality of canonicalSinglePullbackMap (proved from the selected left-derived counit, its single-map comparison and leftAdjointUniq) moves the ordinary f-structure map to the source.

source.place: Tag 08HY, mate construction; Tag 0096, module pullback-pushforward adjunction

proof.text: Conjugate the ordinary moduleBaseChangeMap by the adjunction-preserving tensor-to-ordinary pullback isomorphisms. Precompose with the g comparison, use its naturality and cancel its inverse. The Hom-equivalence identity for leftAdjointUniq identifies the tensor structure map with the comparison followed by pullbackObjUnitToUnit; apply it to p and g. The unit clause of moduleBaseChangeMap_algebra then proves the ordinary structure-map identity. Apply the derived single functor to this equality and reassociate to finish.

lean.statement:
theorem canonical_structure_map_base_change
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (p : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : p ≫ f = f' ≫ g) :
    (derivedPullback g).map
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
            (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
          Scheme.Modules.canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f
            (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) ≫
      (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g p h
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map
          (Scheme.Modules.canonicalSinglePullbackMap p
              (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
                (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit p.toRingCatSheafHom))) =
    (Scheme.Modules.canonicalSinglePullbackMap g (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
            (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom)) ≫
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
            (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f'.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
        Scheme.Modules.canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f'
          (SheafOfModules.unit X'.ringCatSheaf))
